meta.description: Player dialogue lines grouped by game stage. Pick randomly from each group.
meta.delivery: Conversational and understated at first; increasingly tense as truth emerges. Pause at ellipses.

intro.description: Before C1 - player arrives and gets locked in

lines.text: Underground bunker. Four dead lines. There goes my afternoon.
Hang on… Why's the door closing?
My card worked thirty seconds ago.
Fine. You handle the door. I'll handle the phones.

c1_complete.description: After completing C1 - first digit recovered, starting to find clues

lines.text: Stored recordings? I'm here to fix a line. Why bring that up?
Let's see what's keeping you quiet.
Authorised at eight fourteen… I didn't get here until ten.

c2_complete.description: After completing C2 - discovering the conspiracy

lines.text: You said it was a malfunction. Why was there a lockdown order before I arrived?
Right. A precaution.
Home numbers. Private conversations. None of these people knew.
I know this routing. This is what I flagged in my report.

c3_complete.description: After completing C3 - realizing the trap and finding hope

lines.text: That's why they sent me.
I remember that name. They said he'd transferred.
Four systems. Four digits. He left a way out.
I'm copying these recordings. All of them.

c4_complete.description: After completing C4 - all digits recovered, confrontation

lines.text: Just working through the faults. Like you asked.
You broke the lines yourself. Then put my name on the callout.
I've got the order. Your voice is on it.
Hello? …Yeah. Thought so.
That's the last digit. Time to leave.
There it is. Just one more lock.
No. Slow down. Check the fragments.
Come on… Yes. Yes!
He said this leads outside. Please let him be right.
What was that?
I'm out. Now I need to get these recordings to someone.
